synthesizedFacts.fact: Salicylic acid is a beta-hydroxy acid (BHA) used primarily for treating acne and exfoliating the skin.
Salicylic acid works by breaking down layers of thick skin, promoting skin cell turnover, and decreasing inflammation.
Over-the-counter salicylic acid products typically contain concentrations ranging from 0.5% to 2%.
Salicylic acid can cause side effects such as dryness, peeling, and irritation, especially when used with other active ingredients like retinoids.
